title: Template renderer with escapes
prompt: Write a function render(template, values) that substitutes {name} placeholders in template using the dict values. A literal brace is written as {{ for { and }} for }. A placeholder name is one or more characters that are letters, digits or underscores; anything else inside braces makes the template invalid and must raise ValueError. A placeholder whose name is absent from values must raise KeyError. An unterminated escape or an unterminated placeholder is invalid and must raise ValueError.
